members.name: filter
members.doc: Construct a list from those elements of the iterable NAMES that match PAT.

members.name: fnmatch
members.doc: Test whether FILENAME matches PATTERN. Patterns are Unix shell style: * matches everything ? matches any single character [seq] matches any character in seq [!s

members.name: fnmatchcase
members.doc: Test whether FILENAME matches PATTERN, including case. This is a version of fnmatch() which doesn't case-normalize its arguments.

members.name: translate
members.doc: Translate a shell PATTERN to a regular expression. There is no way to quote meta-characters.
